name: 3D Printing Holes
description: Holes made for 3D printing. Teardrop: select sketch circles, then run it; each gets a small tip a few percent of the radius above it (it follows the radius), so the top of a horizontal hole does not sag.

scope.title: Circles
scope.description: selected = the sketch circles currently selected; all in sketch = every (non-construction) circle of the open sketch.

up.title: Up (tip direction)
up.description: Where the tip points. auto = world +Z (the print direction) projected into the sketch; +x, -x, +y, -y = sketch axes; angle = the angle below.

up_angle.title: Up angle (deg)
up_angle.description: Only with Up = angle: direction of the tip in degrees from sketch X (90 = sketch +Y).

warn_horizontal.title: Warn on horizontal sketch
warn_horizontal.description: With Up = auto on a horizontal sketch, world +Z gives no direction and the tip points to sketch +Y. Warn about it (turn off when the part prints in another orientation anyway).

tip_extra.title: Tip above circle (% of r)
tip_extra.description: How far the tip rises above the circle, in percent of the radius: tip at r * (1 + p/100) from the centre. A few percent bridge the sagging top of a printed hole.

tip_height.title: Tip height
tip_height.description: Optional override: distance from the centre to the tip, in mm or an expression where r is the radius (e.g. r + 0.3 mm, or r*sqrt(2) for a classic 45 deg teardrop). Empty: from Tip above circle.

flat_top.title: Flat top at
flat_top.description: Optional: cut the tip flat at this distance from the centre, in mm or an expression in r (e.g. r or 1.1*r). Empty: pointed tip.
